aboutText: S.J. Electric is proud to be one of Australia's foremost electrical services providers, reaching clients in metropolitan areas and remote regions. Based in Thomastown, we have been delivering specialised electrical solutions for over 20 years. Our team is committed to quality workmanship and reliable service, ensuring every project meets the highest standards. Whether for homes or businesses, we are your trusted local electricians.
